stem.en: Why do basal cell/squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma behave so differently (e.g. melanoma spreading far more readily), even though both can be triggered by UV damage?
stem.et: Miks käituvad basaalrakuline/lamerakuline kartsinoom ja melanoom nii erinevalt (nt melanoom levib palju kergemini), kuigi mõlemat võib vallandada UV-kahjustus?

label.en: Because they arise from different cell types -- basal cell/squamous cell carcinoma from keratinocytes, melanoma from melanocytes -- and that different cell of origin, not just how much UV damage occurred, drives their very different growth and metastatic behavior.
label.et: Sest need tekivad erinevatest rakutüüpidest -- basaalrakuline/lamerakuline kartsinoom keratinotsüütidest, melanoom melanotsüütidest -- ning see erinev rakupäritolu, mitte lihtsalt see, kui palju UV-kahjustust tekkis, juhib nende väga erinevat kasvu- ja metastaseerumiskäitumist.

label.en: Melanoma is simply a later, more advanced stage of the same disease process as basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma, having progressed further before diagnosis.
label.et: Melanoom on lihtsalt hilisem, kaugemale arenenud staadium samast haigusprotsessist, mis on enne diagnoosimist rohkem edenenud.

label.en: Because melanoma only occurs after a history of severe, blistering sunburns, while basal cell/squamous cell carcinoma results from any other UV exposure pattern.
label.et: Sest melanoom tekib ainult pärast tõsiste, villidega päikesepõletuste ajalugu, samas kui basaalrakuline/lamerakuline kartsinoom tuleneb mistahes muust UV kokkupuute mustrist.

label.en: Because melanoma only affects fair-skinned people, whose lack of melanin makes their melanocytes uniquely vulnerable in a way keratinocytes never are.
label.et: Sest melanoom mõjutab ainult heledanahalisi inimesi, kelle melaniinipuudus muudab nende melanotsüüdid unikaalselt haavatavaks viisil, mida keratinotsüütidel kunagi ei esine.
